strings.frt.title: Forest of Whispers
strings.frt.tagline: Deep in the forest, signs bear your first name and the paths keep shifting. The farther you go, the more the old relay station seems to call to you.
strings.frt.s01.title: The Gateway
strings.frt.s01.body: The wood of the gateway is damp, as if it had just been put up. Beyond it, the light quickly fades under the trees. A smell of cold metal hangs in the air, even though it is not the season for it.
strings.frt.s01.c2: Look along the edges of the path
strings.frt.h.s01.soft: The silence is not normal: something is following a rhythm.
strings.frt.h.s01.strong: You have to cross the gateway for the loop to truly begin.
strings.frt.s02.title: The Direction Post
strings.frt.s02.body: Arrows everywhere. One looks lighter, less damp, as if it were newer. You can read just enough to understand that it points to you, not to a place.
strings.frt.s02.c3: Touch the arrow with your fingertips
strings.frt.h.s02.soft: The newest-looking markers are not reassuring here.
strings.frt.h.s02.strong: Touching the arrow or noticing that it is strange helps you understand that your first name is being used.
strings.frt.s03.title: The First Tunnel of Trees
strings.frt.s03.body: The path narrows. The branches almost form a ceiling. Your breath turns to mist — and you have the feeling another mist answers it, one yard ahead.
strings.frt.s03.c2: Turn around for just a second
strings.frt.s03.c3: Slow down and count your steps
strings.frt.h.s03.soft: The more you look back, the more the past changes.
strings.frt.h.s03.strong: Moving forward leads you to the crossroads and the main progression.
strings.frt.s04.title: The Sign with Your Name
strings.frt.s04.body: A small makeshift sign on a stake. Your first name, or something very close to it, is there… but the letters seem to move when you stare at them. Like a focus that never settles.
strings.frt.s04.c1: Act like you did not see anything
strings.frt.s04.c2: Admit that it is meant for you
strings.frt.h.s04.soft: This place wants you to recognize yourself.
strings.frt.h.s04.strong: Accepting the idea prepares you to follow the logic of the clues rather than the logic of the paths.
strings.frt.s05.title: The Crossroads
strings.frt.s05.body: Two paths. Same width. Same mud. Yet one sounds hollower under your steps, as if the ground were empty beneath it.
strings.frt.s05.c3: Stay in the middle and observe
strings.frt.h.s05.soft: The ground speaks more honestly than the signs.
strings.frt.h.s05.strong: Watching from the center leads to the first real markers.
strings.frt.s06.title: The Ribbon
strings.frt.s06.body: A pale ribbon is tied around a tree trunk. It moves without wind. When you get closer, it goes still, as if pretending.
strings.frt.s06.c2: Leave it, but memorize the tree
strings.frt.h.s06.soft: The human-looking markers here seem shy.
strings.frt.h.s06.strong: The ribbon is useful later to stabilize a passage.
strings.frt.s07.title: The Circle of Stones
strings.frt.s07.body: A circle of mossy stones. The center is darker than shadow. Your flashlight seems to grow tired there.
strings.frt.h.s07.soft: Some places do not want to be lit.
strings.frt.h.s07.strong: The circle serves as a landmark: you can notice changes there.
strings.frt.s08.title: The Repeating Walk
strings.frt.s08.body: You move forward… and recognize the same root, the same rock, the same mark. Not in the same place: in the same instant. Like a short loop.
strings.frt.s08.c1: Force the loop by speeding up
strings.frt.s08.c2: Look for a detail that is different
strings.frt.s08.c3: Go back to the direction post
strings.frt.h.s08.soft: Time is not linear here, it is folded.
strings.frt.h.s08.strong: Looking for a detail leads to the first useful tool.
strings.frt.s09.title: The Changed Arrows
strings.frt.s09.body: The post is there… but the arrows no longer point the same way. And the sign with your name seems to be waiting for you already, as if it had moved ahead of you.
strings.frt.s09.c2: Go back to the center of the crossroads
strings.frt.s09.c3: Return to the sign with your name
strings.frt.h.s09.soft: Objects hold memory better than paths do.
strings.frt.h.s09.strong: Going back to your name strengthens the “you are expected” axis and unlocks clue scenes.
strings.frt.s10.title: The Damp Map
strings.frt.s10.body: A map on a stump. It is damp, as if it had been placed there a minute ago. The lines seem to shift gently, in time with a breath.
strings.frt.s10.c2: Compare the map and the ground
strings.frt.h.s10.soft: The map is not lost: it was left there.
strings.frt.h.s10.strong: Taking the map helps avoid false returns and opens more logical paths.
strings.frt.s11.title: The Ribbon That Refuses
strings.frt.s11.body: The ribbon sticks to your fingers for a second. Not like glue: more like it is hesitating to let you go.
strings.frt.h.s11.soft: Even a marker can test you.
strings.frt.h.s11.strong: The marked tree leads to a presence scene.
strings.frt.s12.title: The Pressure of the Branches
strings.frt.s12.body: The branches hang lower. You have to bend down. The back of your neck grows warm as if someone were breathing close behind you.
strings.frt.s12.c2: Look for a more open spot
strings.frt.h.s12.soft: The tighter it gets, the more directed it becomes.
strings.frt.s13.title: The Fallen Trunk
strings.frt.s13.body: A trunk blocks the path. There is enough space underneath to crawl. Except the space looks darker than the night around it, like a hole in the image.
strings.frt.s13.c3: Back away toward the circle of stones
strings.frt.h.s13.strong: Going underneath gets you to the relay faster, but increases the risk of a bad ending.
strings.frt.s14.title: The Unsteady Needle
strings.frt.s14.body: A compass lies in the mud, as if forgotten. The needle trembles. It is not looking for north: it is looking for a place.
strings.frt.s14.c2: Follow the needle without taking it
strings.frt.s14.c3: Go back the way you came
strings.frt.h.s14.strong: The compass helps confirm the tower and cuts down useless loops.
strings.frt.s15.title: Your Name Twice
strings.frt.s15.body: A second sign. Your first name again. This time, it is… shorter. As if someone had learned it and was now shortening it.
strings.frt.s15.c1: Admit that the forest is calling you
strings.frt.h.s15.soft: The longer you stay, the more familiar the place becomes.
strings.frt.h.s15.strong: Following the direction leads you to the cabin.
strings.frt.s16.title: Sliding Lines
strings.frt.s16.body: On the map, the paths move very slowly, like snakes under paper. One line seems to align when you hold your breath.
strings.frt.s16.c1: Test your breath to freeze the map
strings.frt.h.s16.strong: Finding a symbol gives you a stable direction toward the relay.
strings.frt.s17.title: The Cold Center
strings.frt.s17.body: At the edge of the circle of stones, you hear a faint mechanical breath. Like a speaker far away, hidden under the ground.
strings.frt.s17.c1: Press your ear to the ground
strings.frt.h.s17.strong: The circle is a listening point: you can catch the frequency there later.
strings.frt.s18.title: The Delayed Reflection
strings.frt.s18.body: In a puddle, your reflection blinks half a second too late. You straighten up. A black surface between two trees shows the same thing: a delay.
strings.frt.h.s18.soft: The place is synchronizing with you… and failing at first.
strings.frt.s19.title: Red Light in the Distance
strings.frt.s19.body: Between the trees, a faint red light. It blinks slowly, steadily. Not a house. Not a car. A beacon.
strings.frt.s19.c3: Go back to the narrow place
strings.frt.h.s19.soft: The blinking feels like a heartbeat.
strings.frt.h.s19.strong: The red light is the radio relay. That is the central objective.
strings.frt.s20.title: You Are Never in the Same Place
strings.frt.s20.body: You come back to a crossroads… but it is not the same one. The trees have the same shape, the stones the same moss, and yet the air is different, drier.
strings.frt.s20.c1: Follow the memory of the tower
strings.frt.s20.c2: Look for a sign with your name
strings.frt.h.s20.soft: The forest copies, it does not preserve.
strings.frt.h.s20.strong: Following the tower leads to the entrance of the relay site.
strings.frt.s21.title: Under the Trunk
strings.frt.s21.body: Under the trunk, the air is colder. You crawl. For one second, you feel a hand on your ankle. When you turn around, there is only bark.
strings.frt.s21.c1: Keep going to the other side
strings.frt.s21.c3: Close your eyes and move forward
strings.frt.h.s21.soft: The contact may be an illusion… but your body believes it.
strings.frt.h.s21.strong: This passage speeds you toward danger scenes.
strings.frt.s22.title: No North
strings.frt.s22.body: The compass spins, then points sharply… in the same direction as the red light. It feels more like a decision than a measurement.
strings.frt.s22.c3: Go back to the starting point
strings.frt.h.s22.soft: When a tool chooses, you should be careful.
strings.frt.h.s22.strong: Compass and map together give reliable progress toward the relay.
strings.frt.s23.title: The Cabin
strings.frt.s23.body: A cabin takes shape. Too intact to be abandoned. The window is black, yet you feel like it is looking at you. The door creaks… before you even touch it.
strings.frt.h.s23.soft: The cabin is waiting for you like a chapter.
strings.frt.s24.title: Ground vs Map
strings.frt.s24.body: On the map, one route leads to a fence. On the ground, you see… an absence. As if the forest refused to show you the straight line.
strings.frt.h.s24.soft: Here, even your instinct can be wrong.
strings.frt.h.s24.strong: The compass is required to force a stable path.
strings.frt.s25.title: The Metallic Breath
strings.frt.s25.body: A faint crackle in the air, as if a hidden speaker were searching for a station. Then, very low, a voice cuts in: “...identify yourself...”
strings.frt.s25.c1: Try to hear the whole sentence
strings.frt.s25.c3: Go back to the sign with your name
strings.frt.h.s25.soft: The sound is not in the air: it is inside you.
strings.frt.h.s25.strong: Listening gives you the trail of the frequency.
strings.frt.s26.title: The Moved Stone
strings.frt.s26.body: In the circle, one stone has been turned over recently. It is darker underneath, as if it had been placed back only a short while ago. A detail the forest has not aged.
strings.frt.s26.c2: Step back and note the spot
strings.frt.h.s26.strong: The circle is used to catch the frequency later.
strings.frt.s27.title: The Black Surface
strings.frt.s27.body: It is not a mirror. It is a frameless pane of glass, hanging between two trunks. It reflects… a concrete hallway. And your silhouette inside it, as if you were already somewhere else.
strings.frt.h.s27.soft: The relay is not only a place: it is a state.
strings.frt.h.s27.strong: This scene foreshadows the Operator and the bunker.
strings.frt.s28.title: The Relay Between the Trees
strings.frt.s28.body: The tower is closer. The red blinking makes you nauseous, like a heartbeat that is too slow. You sense the fence before you even see it.
strings.frt.h.s28.soft: When you move away, the forest recenters you.
strings.frt.h.s28.strong: The fence is the next hub.
strings.frt.s29.title: The Path That Unfolds
strings.frt.s29.body: The path suddenly widens like a ribbon pulled from a drawer. You realize the path is placing you somewhere more than it is letting you move forward.
strings.frt.s29.c2: Go back to the previous choice
strings.frt.h.s29.strong: Signs rarely confirm: they guide you toward trap or cabin.
strings.frt.s30.title: The “For You” Sign
strings.frt.s30.body: A single arrow. Your first name underneath. And one word you read all too clearly: “EXPECTED.” The wood is dry, as if it had just been cut.
strings.frt.h.s30.soft: Dry wood in a damp forest is a break in the pattern.
strings.frt.h.s30.strong: The EXPECTED arrow leads to the cabin and the evidence.
strings.frt.s31.title: Cabin, Version 2
strings.frt.s31.body: The cabin is there… but not at the same angle. The chain is different. And yet the black window is identical. As if only the front had changed.
strings.frt.h.s31.soft: You are visiting a copy that corrects itself in real time.
strings.frt.h.s31.strong: Inside, you can get note and tape.
strings.frt.s32.title: The Too-Quiet Path
strings.frt.s32.body: No more insect sounds. No more wind. Just your steps. Then a tiny click, like a button being brushed.
strings.frt.h.s32.soft: The click is not natural: it is an interface.
strings.frt.h.s32.strong: The click leads to a speaker scene.
strings.frt.s33.title: Aligned Needle
strings.frt.s33.body: The compass calms down. The needle stops trembling and points straight. You feel that if you do not follow now, it will start lying again.
strings.frt.s33.c1: Follow the needle toward the tower
strings.frt.s33.c2: Cut through on a secondary path
strings.frt.s33.c3: Go back to the previous point
strings.frt.h.s33.strong: When the compass is steady, go to the relay.
strings.frt.s34.title: Table and Notebook
strings.frt.s34.body: Inside, a table. An open notebook. A penciled sentence: “IF YOU ARE READING THIS, THEN YOU HEARD IT.” The pages are slightly sticky.
strings.frt.h.s34.soft: The notebook describes you without insulting you: like a set of instructions.
strings.frt.h.s34.strong: The notebook can lead to the code and the secret route.
strings.frt.s35.title: Around the Cabin
strings.frt.s35.body: Behind the cabin, a small mound, as if something were buried. The dirt is darker. And the smell of old plastic brushes past you.
strings.frt.s35.c1: Dig a little with your hands
strings.frt.h.s35.soft: The smell of plastic in a forest is a clue of technology.
strings.frt.h.s35.strong: The mound foreshadows the bunker and technical objects.
strings.frt.s36.title: Stabilized Path
strings.frt.s36.body: For the first time, you walk for ten seconds without feeling the ground shift. It is almost a relief — and that is what scares you.
strings.frt.s36.c2: Go back the way you came
strings.frt.h.s36.strong: Stable stretches bring you closer to the relay without looping.
strings.frt.s37.title: The Ribbon Was Not Alone
strings.frt.s37.body: You find a second ribbon… then a third. They do not mark a path: they mark a rhythm. Like sound beacons, but visual.
strings.frt.s37.c1: Follow the rhythm of the ribbons
strings.frt.s37.c2: Ignore it and go back to the path
strings.frt.s37.c3: Go back to the first ribbon
strings.frt.h.s37.soft: The forest is giving you a method, not a direction.
strings.frt.h.s37.strong: With a ribbon, you can create stabilization later.
strings.frt.s38.title: Full Sentence
strings.frt.s38.body: The voice returns, clearer: “Identify yourself on the frequency. Do not cut off.” Then, very low, a string of numbers, like a station.
strings.frt.s38.c3: Follow the voice instead of the numbers
strings.frt.h.s38.soft: The place prefers an instruction over an explanation.
strings.frt.h.s38.strong: The frequency is a logical key for the relay and the exit.
strings.frt.s39.title: Return Without Return
strings.frt.s39.body: You try to go back — and you do come back… but not to the same place. A new sign has appeared, as if it had been placed there while you blinked.
strings.frt.h.s39.strong: Reading the signs can lead you to an alarm or a shortcut.
strings.frt.s40.title: A Wire Under the Moss
strings.frt.s40.body: At the center of the circle, you spot a very thin wire disappearing under the moss. It vibrates in pulses, as if driven by an impulse.
strings.frt.h.s40.soft: Technology hides under nature, not inside it.
strings.frt.h.s40.strong: The wire links to the relay and the bunker.
strings.frt.s41.title: The Answer
strings.frt.s41.body: You whisper something, almost nothing. And the forest answers with a crackle that sounds like your breath, only more rhythmic. As if it had been recorded.
strings.frt.s41.c3: Back away toward the black glass
strings.frt.h.s41.strong: Speaking the frequency triggers the presence of the Operator.
strings.frt.s42.title: Fence and Gate
strings.frt.s42.body: The fence is there. A sign too faded to read, too old. The gate is neither open nor closed: it is waiting, as if a hand were about to decide.
strings.frt.s42.c2: Look for a camera or a sensor
strings.frt.h.s42.soft: The industrial place is more honest: it does not pretend to be natural.
strings.frt.h.s42.strong: Going in is the relay hub.
strings.frt.s43.title: The Relay Yard
strings.frt.s43.body: Tall grass, cables on the ground, a small outbuilding. You hear a very faint hum, like a machine that never sleeps.
strings.frt.h.s43.soft: The hum sounds like an artificial heart.
strings.frt.h.s43.strong: Following the cables helps locate the bunker and the mic table.
strings.frt.s44.title: Moved Ribbon
strings.frt.s44.body: You find a ribbon again… but it is on another tree. Either someone moved it, or the scenery shifted around it. Both possibilities make you equally sick.
strings.frt.s44.c1: Use the ribbon as an anchor
strings.frt.s44.c3: Go back to the EXPECTED sign
strings.frt.h.s44.soft: Markers move when nobody is watching them.
strings.frt.h.s44.strong: The ribbon later lets you stabilize a passage.
strings.frt.s45.title: EXPECTED, Again
strings.frt.s45.body: The same word. Your first name underneath. This time, with a small symbol added: a crossed-out circle, like a muted speaker. It makes you want to talk.
strings.frt.s45.c3: Look for where the crackling comes from
strings.frt.h.s45.soft: The symbol manipulates you by suggestion.
strings.frt.h.s45.strong: Following EXPECTED leads to the relay through the method.
strings.frt.s46.title: The Notebook Insists
strings.frt.s46.body: A page stuck to the notebook by dampness. When you peel it apart, numbers appear underneath, as if printed by pressure. No accident: a code.
strings.frt.h.s46.soft: The pages reveal information only if you make the gesture.
strings.frt.h.s46.strong: The code is used later in the control room.
strings.frt.s47.title: The Repeated Click
strings.frt.s47.body: The click returns. Then a second one. A simple rhythm, like a push button. You realize you could answer by tapping your foot.
strings.frt.s48.title: Lines and Numbers
strings.frt.s48.body: The notebook is not a journal: it is a guide. It links the map to the frequency. It describes a stabilization using a ribbon and a breath.
strings.frt.h.s48.soft: Someone wrote it for someone who would come after.
strings.frt.h.s48.strong: Notebook and frequency can produce a code.
strings.frt.s49.title: Microphone and Tape
strings.frt.s49.body: Under a cloth, a small tape recorder and a cassette. The REC button is slightly pressed in, as if someone had pushed it… then left it there.
strings.frt.h.s49.soft: The pressed REC button makes you feel already recorded.
strings.frt.h.s49.strong: The tape is useful evidence for the good ending and can feed the secret route.
strings.frt.s50.title: The Glass Is Watching You
strings.frt.s50.body: The black glass is back. This time, you do not see the hallway in it: you see the tower. And in the reflection, a silhouette behind you with no detail.
strings.frt.s50.c2: Use the map to confirm the angle
strings.frt.h.s50.strong: The map helps avoid being placed back into a loop.
strings.frt.s51.title: Tower: Confirmation
strings.frt.s51.body: The red light is stronger. It cuts the trees into bars. You taste the fence in your mouth, metallic, without having touched it.
strings.frt.h.s51.soft: The closer you get, the more measured you feel.
strings.frt.h.s51.strong: You must reach the fence to access the bunker and the good ending.
strings.frt.s52.title: Stabilize
strings.frt.s52.body: You tie a ribbon at a precise angle, just as the notebook suggests. The air changes. For two seconds, the path stops moving. Then everything starts again.
strings.frt.s52.c1: Use the moment and move forward
strings.frt.h.s52.soft: The forest hates it when you make it predictable.
strings.frt.h.s52.strong: Stabilization can be a requirement for a good exit.
strings.frt.s53.title: You Have the Station
strings.frt.s53.body: The numbers turn in your head like a simple song. You whisper them — and the crackling fades, as if you had given the right password.
strings.frt.s53.c2: Stay and listen for a second sentence
strings.frt.h.s53.strong: Frequency, code, and recording eventually lead to the secret route.
strings.frt.s54.title: RAPID Sign
strings.frt.s54.body: A sign appears: “RAPID.” Your first name underneath. The smell of metal returns. You understand: one path is promising to save you time.
strings.frt.h.s54.soft: The place is offering you a temptation.
strings.frt.h.s54.strong: The RAPID path leads to the red alarm and the bad ending.
strings.frt.s55.title: Your Name in Small Letters
strings.frt.s55.body: Your first name is written smaller, more discreetly. Like a habit. It chills you: the forest is no longer shouting. It whispers, confident now.
strings.frt.s55.c1: Follow the voice to the tower
strings.frt.h.s55.soft: Once it becomes subtle, it means it has settled in.
strings.frt.h.s55.strong: If you heard the broadcast, you can follow a voice to the relay.
strings.frt.s56.title: The Wire Is Real
strings.frt.s56.body: You follow the wire under the moss. It leads to… nothing. Then, suddenly, to a place you had never seen before: a perfectly straight passage between two trees.
strings.frt.h.s56.soft: The straight line is a confession.
strings.frt.h.s56.strong: With the frequency, this passage gets you closer to the relay reliably.
strings.frt.s57.title: The Operator
strings.frt.s57.body: A feeling of presence, like someone beside you. Not hostile. Calm, almost professional. You hear breathing that is not yours, and one word: “Procedure.”
strings.frt.s57.c1: Ask what is expected of you
strings.frt.s57.c2: Tear yourself away from the place
strings.frt.h.s57.soft: The presence behaves like an employee, not like a monster.
strings.frt.h.s57.strong: The Operator is the pivot of the secret ending.
strings.frt.s58.title: The Place That Wants You to Stay
strings.frt.s58.body: You feel held back by the air, like a hand without a hand. The ground is not sticky, but your body hesitates to leave. And you understand: that is what they want.
strings.frt.s58.c1: Resist and go back toward the presence
strings.frt.h.s58.soft: The restraint is mental, not physical.
strings.frt.h.s58.strong: The complete silence is a trap leading to the bad ending.
strings.frt.s59.title: Inside
strings.frt.s59.body: You pass through the gate. The air changes: less humus, more dry dust. A cable crosses the yard like a vein in the open.
strings.frt.h.s59.soft: The site looks abandoned, but something maintains it.
strings.frt.h.s59.strong: The cable leads to the bunker or to a mic table.
strings.frt.s60.title: The Bunker Door
strings.frt.s60.body: A half-buried metal door. The handle is cold, too cold. A faded symbol looks like a crossed-out ear. You feel like it is missing a key… or authorization.
strings.frt.h.s60.soft: The bunker is not closed: it is reserved.
strings.frt.s61.title: The Fence Follows You
strings.frt.s61.body: As you walk along the fence, you feel like it is moving with you. Not visibly. More like a subtle correction: the right distance, the right angle, the right trajectory. A sign is riveted on crooked, and yet it looks straight at you.
strings.frt.s61.c2: Go back the way you came
strings.frt.h.s61.soft: The more you follow it, the more the site seems to keep you in a corridor.
strings.frt.h.s61.strong: The bunker key is on the site: you need to explore the yard and the mic table.
strings.frt.s62.title: The Mic Table
strings.frt.s62.body: Under a collapsed awning, an improvised table. A microphone, a lamp, crumpled papers. The dust is old… except in the center, as if wiped by a recent palm. On one sheet, one word: “AUTHORIZATION.” And a small metal object wedged under the leg.
strings.frt.s62.c1: Lift the object and look underneath
strings.frt.s62.c2: Go back toward the bunker door
strings.frt.h.s62.soft: Used objects are not the cleanest ones: they are the sharpest ones.
strings.frt.h.s62.strong: The bunker key is here: without it, you just circle the door.
strings.frt.s63.title: Labels and Procedures
strings.frt.s63.body: The microphone is connected to a small box covered in labels: frequencies, channels, schedules. Some lines are crossed out, as if someone had changed the instructions midway. A note says: “DO NOT CUT OFF.” And a key, taped behind it, waits like a deliberate oversight.
strings.frt.s63.c1: Take the key and keep it
strings.frt.h.s63.soft: Everything looks administrative, and that is what makes it worse.
strings.frt.h.s63.strong: The key unlocks the bunker door, a direct path to the endings.
strings.frt.s64.title: The Invisible Speaker
strings.frt.s64.body: The crackling comes from nowhere, then seems to come from everywhere. The voice cuts in, sharp, emotionless: “Identify yourself.” A second voice repeats the same thing with a slight delay, like a recording.
strings.frt.s64.c1: Play the tape and listen to the end
strings.frt.s64.c2: Back away before hearing your name
strings.frt.s64.c3: Go back to the too-quiet path
strings.frt.h.s64.soft: The delay is a signature: something is replaying reality.
strings.frt.h.s64.strong: Listening triggers the broadcast flag, useful for the frequency.
strings.frt.s65.title: The Code Under the Page
strings.frt.s65.body: You pick up the notebook again. A page glued by dampness nearly tears on its own, as if it wanted to be opened. Underneath: numbers, but not a frequency. A short, precise code, written like a technical instruction. It looks like a door waiting for its combination.
strings.frt.s65.c1: Memorize the code and keep it for the relay
strings.frt.s65.c2: Put the notebook away and breathe
strings.frt.s65.c3: Go back to the cabin entrance
strings.frt.h.s65.soft: Information appears when you make the exact gesture.
strings.frt.h.s65.strong: The code is one piece of the secret route.
strings.frt.s66.title: The Map Lies Less
strings.frt.s66.body: The map still moves, but more slowly. As if it is accepting part of your presence. The lines stop sliding as soon as you fix your eyes on a distant point. A fence symbol stabilizes, and you understand that you can force the logic if you stick to it.
strings.frt.s66.c1: Go back toward the stable segments
strings.frt.s66.c2: Follow the line that leads to the bunker
strings.frt.s66.c3: Return to the spot where you found the map
strings.frt.h.s66.soft: The map does not guide you: it tests how you read.
strings.frt.h.s66.strong: The map is an anti-loop net: it reduces useless returns.
strings.frt.s67.title: The Tape Chooses You
strings.frt.s67.body: The tape is heavier than expected. Holding it, you hear faint white breath, as if it were already playing. The REC button makes your fingers itch. You feel that you could record something… or be recorded in its place.
strings.frt.s67.c2: Go to the relay with the tape
strings.frt.h.s67.soft: Evidence is not evidence if it transforms you.
strings.frt.h.s67.strong: The tape is used to make real evidence and can feed the secret route.
strings.frt.s68.title: The Plan Connects
strings.frt.s68.body: On the map, one line aligns exactly with a ribbon. Not by chance: a connection. As if the forest agreed, for a few seconds, to let a straight line exist. Your breath keeps it all in place, fragile, like a focus.
strings.frt.h.s68.soft: The place becomes readable when you make it predictable.
strings.frt.h.s68.strong: Ribbon and stabilization can secure the good exit.
strings.frt.s69.title: The Nearby Presence
strings.frt.s69.body: You sense a step behind you. Not a crack: a real step. Something follows a human rhythm, without hurrying. When you stop, the step stops. When you breathe, it follows your rhythm. You understand that it is not chasing you: it is imitating you.
strings.frt.s69.c2: Go back to the black glass
strings.frt.h.s69.soft: What follows you does not need to run.
strings.frt.h.s69.strong: The Operator is a pivot of the secret route.
strings.frt.s70.title: The Stable Moment
strings.frt.s70.body: The ribbon holds. The path, for a short moment, stops correcting itself. You feel that if you miss this moment, you will fall back into the copies. A window. A chance. Even the air feels straighter.
strings.frt.s70.c1: Use the stable moment and rush toward the tower
strings.frt.s70.c2: Stay and check the map one last time
strings.frt.h.s70.soft: Fear makes you lose the only useful seconds.
strings.frt.h.s70.strong: The stable moment gets you to the relay zone without looping.
strings.frt.s71.title: Back to the Gate
strings.frt.s71.body: The gate is identical… except for one detail: the padlock has turned on its own, as if straightening itself. You feel like someone saw you come back. A simple idea crosses your mind: here, they were waiting for you.
strings.frt.h.s71.soft: The industrial site treats you like a file, not like prey.
strings.frt.h.s71.strong: The bunker is the required passage: key and door lead to the endings.
strings.frt.s72.title: The Red Hallway
strings.frt.s72.body: A red light comes on without warning, like an alarm that was waiting for your step. The hallway smells of hot metal even though it is cold. The crackling grows louder, closer, almost in your teeth. You understand: you have entered an active zone.
strings.frt.s72.c2: Back up and catch your breath
strings.frt.h.s72.soft: The red does not signal danger: it signals intake.
strings.frt.h.s72.strong: Speaking here pushes you toward the bad ending: the place hooks you.
strings.frt.s73.title: REC
strings.frt.s73.body: A REC light comes on somewhere, invisible, and you feel it more than you see it. Your voice already feels recorded. You could make evidence, real evidence… or hand yourself over. The line is thin, and that is what makes your hands shake.
strings.frt.s73.c2: Follow the red hallway without speaking
strings.frt.s73.c3: Let go and accept the flow
strings.frt.h.s73.soft: The place loves it when you abandon nuance.
strings.frt.h.s73.strong: Recording with the tape is required for the secret ending.
strings.frt.s74.title: The Repeated Instruction
strings.frt.s74.body: The voice repeats the frequency like a nursery rhyme. You understand that it wants you to say it yourself. Not to guide you. To mark you. A relay noise, a small click, answers from deep inside the site.
strings.frt.s74.c1: Go to the bunker if you have the key
strings.frt.s74.c3: Stay and listen to the rest
strings.frt.h.s74.soft: Repeating an instruction is already obeying.
strings.frt.h.s74.strong: The bunker key lets you avoid the red spiral.
strings.frt.s75.title: The Site Closes In
strings.frt.s75.body: The yard seems smaller than before. The same buildings, but closer together, like a set tightened up. You do not feel trapped: you feel filed away. And the crackling grows… satisfied.
strings.frt.h.s75.soft: The place works better when you go still.
strings.frt.h.s75.strong: Stopping here often leads to the bad ending: you have to go through the bunker.
strings.frt.s76.title: Procedure
strings.frt.s76.body: The Operator is there, without really showing itself. A calm presence near your shoulder. You hear one word, clear: “Procedure.” And you understand that three things are needed to go all the way: the frequency, the code, and the recording. The key only opens the passage.
strings.frt.s76.c1: Start the full procedure if you have everything
strings.frt.s76.c2: Go to the bunker without looking for more
strings.frt.h.s76.soft: The Operator does not threaten: it administers.
strings.frt.h.s76.strong: If frequency, code, and recording are gathered, the true secret route opens.
strings.frt.s77.title: Complete Silence
strings.frt.s77.body: Nothing anymore. No wind. No insects. Not even your steps: as if the ground were absorbing sound. The silence is not soothing. It is loaded. And you understand that it is one of the place’s options: forced silence.
strings.frt.h.s77.soft: Silence is a closed room without walls.
strings.frt.h.s77.strong: Waiting here takes you to the bad ending.
strings.frt.s78.title: The Bunker Lock
strings.frt.s78.body: The key has a precise weight, as if it had been made for this exact gesture. The lock takes it without resistance. One sharp click. Then the door opens slightly.
strings.frt.s78.c3: Stay in front of the door without going in
strings.frt.h.s78.soft: The bunker is not a place: it is a commitment.
strings.frt.h.s78.strong: Going in is required for the secret ending and leads to the endings.
strings.frt.s79.title: Damp Concrete
strings.frt.s79.body: The hallway smells of dry dust… but the walls are damp. A simple inconsistency, terrifying. A tired neon light flickers, and every flicker makes you feel like you lost a second. As if someone were walking in step with you.
strings.frt.s79.c2: Look for the sign or the console
strings.frt.h.s79.soft: The neon does not flicker: it cuts out frames.
strings.frt.h.s79.strong: If the truth is unlocked, you can aim straight for the secret route.
strings.frt.s80.title: Control Room
strings.frt.s80.body: Old consoles. Gauges moving faintly. A chair turned toward you, as if someone had been waiting there for a long time. White breath fills everything, and the question becomes simple: leave now or stay.
strings.frt.s80.c2: Stay, answer, let yourself be taken
strings.frt.s80.c3: Open the secret route if everything is ready
strings.frt.h.s80.soft: The room does not feel frightening: it feels normal.
strings.frt.h.s80.strong: Good ending: you leave. Bad ending: you accept. Secret: full procedure.
strings.frt.s81.title: The NAME Console
strings.frt.s81.body: An old screen lights up. A frequency appears. Then one field: “NAME.” The cursor blinks. This is not a simple form. It is a lock. You understand that if you type, you commit yourself. If you refuse, you stay trapped here.
strings.frt.s81.c1: Activate the secret route and understand this place
strings.frt.s81.c3: Go back to the control room
strings.frt.h.s81.soft: An empty field can be more dangerous than a visible trap.
strings.frt.h.s81.strong: The secret ending depends on the full procedure already being validated.
strings.frt.end_good.title: The Exit
strings.frt.end_good.body: You get out before they can hold you. Dawn is cold, but you are outside. Behind you, the forest already looks normal. And that scares you, because you know it can start again.
strings.frt.h.end_good.soft: Reality lets you go, but it explains nothing.
strings.frt.h.end_good.strong: You escaped the site by leaving at the right moment. You are safe… for now.
strings.frt.end_bad.title: The Signal
strings.frt.end_bad.body: You answer, or you stop resisting. The crackling becomes a simple command. The red light is no longer an alarm, it is a signal you accepted. Later, someone will pass through here. They will hear a voice telling them: “Identify yourself.” And it will be yours.
strings.frt.h.end_bad.soft: The worst part is not fear: it is habit.
strings.frt.h.end_bad.strong: You have been connected to the network: you become a function of the relay.
strings.frt.end_secret.title: Full Assignment
strings.frt.end_secret.body: Everything falls into place as expected: frequency, code, recording. You then understand that the Operator is not a person, but a position. And that the forest is used to recruit. You can leave, but now you know how all of this works. And you will never be able to forget it.
strings.frt.h.end_secret.soft: Understanding is not an antidote: it is a bond.
